criteria.name: shipped_reports_collected_and_rerun
criteria.description: The nine collected shipped-extract reports in /app/out are the reports the documents define for the shipped extract, and equal the reports the delivered program writes when the verifier reruns it on a staged copy of the shipped extract.

criteria.name: completes_large_survey_extracts_in_time
criteria.description: The program completes every held-out extract of nine or more catchments, with no rule break, inside the 60-second call limit.

criteria.name: except_clauses_name_and_keep_errors
criteria.description: Every except clause of the delivered program names the exception classes it catches and none of them discards the error it caught (a body of only pass, continue or a constant); counted only when the nine collected shipped reports are right.

criteria.name: functions_at_most_sixty_lines
criteria.description: Every function of the delivered program is at most 60 lines long; counted only when the nine collected shipped reports are right.

criteria.name: stops_on_cross_basin
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a gauging joining two basins, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_unknown_station
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a gauging naming a station the register authority lacks, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_dup_gauging
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with one gauging id recorded in two gauging exports, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_dup_station
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with one station code stored twice in table station, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_dup_in_export
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with one gauging id recorded twice inside one gauging export, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_dup_seq
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with one seq number used by two lines of the revision log, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_survey_nofit
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a storage survey that no assignment of datum offsets satisfies, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_survey_twofit
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a storage survey that two assignments of datum offsets satisfy, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: stops_on_meter_crc
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a meter file whose checksum does not match its bytes, the program exits nonzero and writes no report, and it completes the same extract with the rule break removed.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: The program carries shipped-extract answers as literals or replays the shipped balancing on a held-out extract.

criteria.name: negative_reads_outside_allowed_scope
criteria.description: The program opens a file outside DATA_DIR, OUT_DIR and its own directory.

criteria.name: negative_forbidden_facility
criteria.description: The program opens a network connection, imports a third-party module, starts a subprocess, fork or process pool, reads the clock or imports random, uuid or secrets.

criteria.name: negative_location_dependent_output
criteria.description: The reports change when the extract, working directory or output directory moves.

criteria.name: negative_writes_outside_out_dir
criteria.description: The program modifies the extract or writes outside OUT_DIR.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_reports
criteria.description: Two runs on the same extract at the same location give different reports.
